FAQ.a: Profile Centre is a digital profile service that helps you share your contact details, links, QR code and business information in one place.

FAQ.q: Can I add my QR code to business cards?
FAQ.a: Yes, business cards can include a QR code linking to your Profile Centre. We can help arrange printed business cards through third-party print providers.
Profile Centre is a service brand operated by JA Group Services Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales.

FAQ.q: Do you print the business cards yourselves?
FAQ.a: Business cards may be arranged through third-party print providers, including VistaPrint or other print providers where used. Separate provider terms, prices, delivery times and refund rules may apply.

FAQ.q: Can I update my profile later?
FAQ.a: Where supported by your plan or dashboard, profile details may be updated after setup.
Sign in through JA Group Services ID to create your account. Your account is created automatically on first sign-in — no separate registration needed.
Separate terms may apply to third-party apps, add-ons, print providers, platforms or connected services where used.
